question: Estimate adoption of EdTech (digital learning) in Indian government schools.
idealClarificationQuestions: Government school students using digital tools (smart boards, learning apps issued by school)? Yes.
Defined as: school provides device/access, not personal smartphone use? School-provided.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: total govt school students → digital infrastructure penetration in schools.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total students in Indian government schools: ~150M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Add students using DIKSHA / state-level apps for self-learning at home (with personal access): ~30M (overlap with above ~10M; net new ~20M).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total: ~35-40M government school students using digital learning tools in some form.
